data.name: Reborn: The Evil Being
data.detailed_description:
Reborn: The Evil Being is an open-world action-adventure game where you explore a stunning and vibrant fantasy world full of magic, mystery, and hidden danger. Play in either third-person or first-person as you battle monsters, uncover secrets, and grow stronger in your quest to find the truth behind your arrival.

✨ Story Overview:

You died in the real world — but your journey wasn’t over. Reborn into a beautiful new universe, you're chosen to defeat the Demon Lord. But when you question the will of the goddess who rules this world, you're stripped of your powers and cast aside. Now, with nothing but your determination, you must survive, grow, and uncover the truth. Who is the real enemy? And what secrets lie beneath this seemingly peaceful world?

🎮 Gameplay Features:

  • ⚔️ Versatile Combat: Master swords, spears, bows, and elemental magic to battle goblins, monsters, guards, and rogue NPCs.

  • 🌄 Expansive Open World: Explore lush landscapes, ancient ruins, hidden caves, and mysterious labyrinths at your own pace.

  • 🧱 Survival & Growth: Start powerless — then unlock new spells, level up, craft gear, and upgrade your weapons.

  • 🧠 Mystery & Progression: Discover lore, solve environmental challenges, and face powerful boss enemies.

  • 👤 Single Player Campaign: No time limits — enjoy a story-rich journey full of freedom and exploration.

  • 🤝 Multiplayer Coming Soon: Co-op and competitive multiplayer modes will be added in future updates.

🕒 Estimated Playtime:

  • 3–5 hours for the main story, with more content and replayability depending on your exploration.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (4 cores / 4 threads)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 / AMD RX 570 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
  • VR Support: No
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (6 cores / 12 threads)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3050 / AMD RX 6600 (6–8 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
  • VR Support: NO
